name: Magical Literary Heroine Natsuki Saves the Literature Club!
source:
A fan sequel that picks up after the end of the original game. As the title implies, Natsuki has apparently gained Magical Literary Heroine powers (that are suspiciously similar to Club President abilities), and needs your help to venture back through the tragedy of the Literature Club in an attempt to fix what went wrong.

Source: [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/magical-literary-heroine-natsuki]DokiMods[/url]
translation:
在原版游戏结束后推出的粉丝续集。正如标题所暗示的，夏树显然已经获得了魔法文学女主角的能力（与俱乐部主席的能力非常相似），并且需要你的帮助来冒险回到文学俱乐部的悲剧中，试图解决问题。

来源：[url=https://dokimods.me/mods/magical-literary-heroine-natsuki]DokiMods[/url]
